params.name: Note Value
params.desc: Sets the base note value / rhythm

params.name: Variation
params.desc: Randomly introduces other note values based on Note Value setting

params.name: Legato
params.desc: Probability for legato transitions between notes (no new gate signal)

params.name: Rest (Voice 1)
params.desc: Probability for musical rests in voice 1

params.name: Rest (Voice 2)
params.desc: Probability for musical rests in voice 2 (polyphonic mode)

params.name: Rest (Voice 3)
params.desc: Probability for musical rests in voice 3 (polyphonic mode)

params.name: LO
params.desc: Sets the lowest note / octave range minimum

params.name: HI
params.desc: Sets the highest note / octave range maximum

params.name: Note Probability C
params.desc: Probability for note C to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability C#
params.desc: Probability for note C# to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability D
params.desc: Probability for note D to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability D#
params.desc: Probability for note D# to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability E
params.desc: Probability for note E to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability F
params.desc: Probability for note F to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability F#
params.desc: Probability for note F# to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability G
params.desc: Probability for note G to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability G#
params.desc: Probability for note G# to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability A
params.desc: Probability for note A to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability A#
params.desc: Probability for note A# to appear in the pattern

params.name: Note Probability B
params.desc: Probability for note B to appear in the pattern

params.name: Dice Rhythm On/Off
params.desc: Toggles dice-mode for the rhythm section on or off

params.name: Dice Melody On/Off
params.desc: Toggles dice-mode for the melody section on or off

params.name: Re-Dice Rhythm
params.desc: Triggers a new random dice roll for the rhythm section (any value)

params.name: Re-Dice Melody
params.desc: Triggers a new random dice roll for the melody section (any value)

params.name: Lock
params.desc: Activates lock-mode; decouples controls from the stochastic engine

params.name: First Step
params.desc: Sets the first step of the pattern (8 values per step)

params.name: Last Step
params.desc: Sets the last step of the pattern (8 values per step)

params.name: Accent Probability
params.desc: Probability for notes to play at maximum velocity (127)

params.name: Standard Velocity
params.desc: Sets the standard MIDI note velocity
